name: isValidEmail
description: True when the text is a well-formed email address, such as ana@example.com.

name: isValidPhone
description: True when the text looks like a phone number: digits with an optional +, spaces, dashes or brackets, 8 to 15 digits in all.

name: slugify
description: Turns a title into a URL-friendly slug: lower case, words joined by dashes.

name: fullName
description: Joins a first and last name in title case, leaving out whichever is empty.

name: initials
description: The first letters of a name's words in capitals, such as AS for Ana Souza.

name: maskEmail
description: Hides most of an email address for messages and logs, such as a***@example.com.

name: wordCount
description: How many words a text has.

name: percentChange
description: The change from one number to another as a percentage, such as 25 for 80 to 100. Empty when the first number is 0.

name: taxBreakdown
description: Splits an amount into net, tax and gross. The rate defaults to 18% GST; set inclusive when the amount already has tax in it.

inputs.name: inclusive
inputs.description: True when the amount already includes the tax

name: orderTotals
description: Adds up order lines ({qty, price}) with an optional discount and tax: item count, subtotal, discount, tax and total.

inputs.name: lines
inputs.description: Order lines, each with qty (default 1) and price

inputs.name: taxRate
inputs.description: Tax rate on the discounted amount, 0.18 for 18%

name: ageOn
description: A person's age in whole years from their birthday, today or on the date given.

inputs.name: onDate
inputs.description: The day to work it out for; today when empty

name: businessDaysBetween
description: Working days (Monday to Friday) from one date to another, counting both. Negative when the end is before the start.

name: addBusinessDays
description: The date a number of working days (Monday to Friday) after a date, such as a due date 5 working days out.

inputs.name: days
inputs.description: Working days to add, 0 or more

name: relativeDay
description: Says how far a date is from today, or from the date given: today, yesterday, tomorrow, 3 days ago or in 5 days.

inputs.name: onDate
inputs.description: The day to count from; today when empty
